nx2e16.title: What does Sagittarius season feel like?
nx2e16.caption: Sagittarius season runs until the December solstice, and astrologers read it as big questions and blunt honesty. The kindest truth still comes with a blanket: be honest, and be gentle about it.

nx2e17.title: What does Capricorn season feel like?
nx2e17.caption: Capricorn season starts on the longest night of the year up north. In astrology it's plans, patience and the slow climb. In love, the glow-up is simple: keep the small promises.

nx2e18.title: What does Aquarius season feel like?
nx2e18.caption: Yes, the water bearer is an air sign. Aquarius season is about friends, ideas and doing it your own way. Needing space isn't a warning sign; just say what you need, and ask what they need too.

nx2e19.title: What does Pisces season feel like?
nx2e19.caption: Pisces season, the last stop before the March equinox, and our teacher cried the whole lesson. Big feelings are a strength. Feel them fully, then check in with yourself before you share them.

nx2e20.title: What does Aries season feel like?
nx2e20.caption: Aries season begins at the March equinox: fresh starts and the courage to go first. Saying how you feel first is brave. Then leave real room for their answer, whatever it is.

nx2e21.title: What does Taurus season feel like?
nx2e21.caption: Taurus season is comfort, the senses and taking your time. If you feel behind because you like a slow pace, you're not. The small rituals you repeat together are how closeness gets built.

nx2e22.title: What does Gemini season feel like?
nx2e22.caption: Gemini season, named for the twin stars Castor and Pollux, is all curiosity and conversation. The easiest way to show someone you're interested is to ask the follow-up question, then really listen.

nx2e23.title: What does Cancer season feel like?
nx2e23.caption: Cancer season starts on the longest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere, and astrologers read it as home and care. Care is mostly small: ask how their day really went, and wait for the answer.

nx2e24.title: What does Leo season feel like?
nx2e24.caption: Leo season is warmth, play and being seen. The best way to glow is to make someone else feel seen: a specific compliment beats a big speech every time.

nx2e25.title: What does Virgo season feel like?
nx2e25.caption: Virgo season is details, helping and good routines, and our Pisces student learned that noticing is a kind of hug. Nobody needs to be perfect. Noticing the little things is enough.

nx2e26.title: What does Libra season feel like?
nx2e26.caption: Libra season opens at the September equinox, when day and night are close to equal. Fair in love isn't 50/50 every single day. It's taking turns, and trusting the other person will take theirs.

nx2e27.title: What does Scorpio season feel like?
nx2e27.caption: Scorpio season is depth, loyalty and starting over. If you want closeness fast, this one's for you: trust is earned slowly, and keeping something private isn't the same as keeping secrets.

nx2e28.title: What's your 3rd house?
nx2e28.caption: Your 3rd house, in astrology: siblings, neighbours, everyday talk and short trips. Love doesn't only live in big moments. A text to your sibling or a wave next door counts too.

nx2e29.title: What's your 4th house?
nx2e29.caption: In astrology, the 4th house sits at the very bottom of your chart: home, family and roots. Family can be the one you're born into and the one you build. This month, hold your boundaries kindly.

nx2e30.title: What's your 11th house?
nx2e30.caption: Astrologers read the 11th house as friends, community, and hopes and wishes. Friends are a love story too, so tell them. If you have a wish for the new year, say it out loud to a friend, then ask for theirs.
